ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) clusters occupying approximately 3-5% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base of contiguous low-intensity pixels. High-contrast white geometric clusters at distal tips. Singular high-intensity vertical segment on the right lobe (medial). Minor white focal spots on lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch; approximate angle of 130-140 degrees relative to horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across both lobes. Distinct high-amplitude irregular notch on the superior margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sweep; convex proximal lobe edges transitioning to concave tapering at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right). Small, scattered high-intensity points on the inferior-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity linear disruption located on the right lobe, approximately 20% distance from the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch on left lobe superior edge; distinct vertical linear scar on right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry due to a large irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
